source.name: Celebra Learning

source.verificationNote: Marketing/legal pages were read via an automated page-to-text step; /e-learning text and JSON-LD were read directly. Re-check live pages before quoting externally.

notes: Celebra's learner content is behind sign-in; none was accessed. No account was created.
Pages requested as a visitor and redirected to sign-in: /subjects, /subjects/{one uuid}, /revision-notes (once each).
No /api/ or /_next/ endpoint was requested by the audit; the site's own pages were read only.
Parent-site /notes is a library of Form 1–4 era uploads of unclear provenance; nothing downloaded.
Third-party mirror headings used for the KICD-side comparison are unverified against KICD.
recommendation: Do not use Celebra as a data source. Keep KICD's own documents as source of record; cite sources precisely; seek KICD permission for outcome text.
